Reading a registry report before quoting a number

By the Example Lab maintainer. Published 2026-10-01. Draft, in review. Research, not medical advice.

Who is counted

A registry counts the people its centres reported in that year, not everyone with the condition.

Denominators

Read the table's own denominator before comparing two years.

How a value is made

Check whether a figure is a median, a mean, or a percentage of a subgroup, and which year's definition applied.

Sources: the report's methods section, and its own list of definition changes.

Research, not medical advice. Content dated 2026-10-01.
